verdict.rationale: Keycloak offers building blocks that could support a migration without password resets: user federation to LDAP/AD, a custom provider you implement yourself for users in other stores such as a relational database, brokering to existing OIDC/SAML identity providers, and realm JSON import plus the Admin REST API and CLI. However, none of this is a vendor-maintained migration guide or tool for leaving a competing auth provider; it takes custom code and assembly on your part. Missing for 10: a first-party migration guide from competing providers, documented password-hash import or lazy-migration tooling that explicitly preserves passwords, and hands-on corroboration of a migration without resets.
